question: A faction's progress and the victory conditions: CFaction::GetVictoryPointShare whole, faction_progress set against it, what the victory conditions are and where they come from, and what meeting them or the end date does to the game.

addresses.name: CFaction::GetVictoryPointShare
addresses.comment:
**The faction's share of the world's victory points, a percentage in thousandths with only a tenth of a percent of resolution.** 0x522CC0 to the single `ret 8` at 0x522DF6; both arguments on the stack, nothing in ECX. Read whole on the listing 2026-10-13:

    TOTAL = sum over i < (state->provinces_end - provinces_begin)/4 of  g_CMap->+0x2200[i]->victory_points (+0x34) * 1000
    *out  = faction->Progress (+0xAC)
    if (TOTAL != 0)  *out = Progress * 1000 / TOTAL          ; 64-bit, truncating (0xB99AF0, 0xB99980)
    *out  = *out * 100000 / 1000                              ; 64-bit, truncating

So the first divide cuts the share to thousandths of one and the second multiplies by 100: **115 of 1172 victory points is 9.800, not 9.812**. TOTAL is every province on the map, sea and land, **simulated or not** - no test of CProvinceTemplate +0x13D - while Progress counts only simulated provinces, so in a scenario the share is of the whole world's points. No cap and no floor. Nothing is cached: TOTAL is summed on every call. The faction is never null (a country in no faction holds the null faction). Three callers: CAlignment::GetRevanchismTerm (0x4C3F60), CDiplomacyView::UpdateFactionBoxes (0x7832F3, which shows it / 1000 - whole per cent, cut), CFactionProgressTrigger::Evaluate (0x9FD3A4). CFaction_BuildProgressTooltip (0x522E00) does the same arithmetic open-coded, so the tooltip's PERCENT, the box and `faction_progress` all agree. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-factionplay.md, section C.
addresses.revises: likely -> confirmed. The old comment said 'divided by the sum ... then multiplied by 100', which is right in effect; added: the two truncating 64-bit steps (0.1% resolution), that the total is every map province unfiltered, that nothing is cached, and the three callers by address.
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0x522CC0..0x522DF6 instruction by instruction: the loop at 0x522D5D..0x522D8C (count from state +0xB90-+0xB8C, element from [0x1A8557C]+0x2200, +0x34 imul 0x3E8), the Progress load at 0x522D94, the TOTAL!=0 gate at 0x522D9F, the two allmul/alldiv pairs with 0x3E8 and 0x186A0/0x3E8. findRefs --callers gives exactly 0x4C3F60, 0x7832F3, 0x9FD3A4. Savegame check: Germany1936_01_01_00 has axis/allies/comintern progress 115/263/173 and 1172 world VP; the formula gives 9800/22400/14700. Wrong if a fourth caller exists through a register call (none found by the rel32 scan), or if g_CMap +0x2200 is not indexed in the same order as the game state's province vector (the count comes from one and the pointer from the other).

addresses.name: CFaction::GetNormalizedProgress
addresses.comment: **Lua's `CFaction:GetNormalizedProgress()`: this faction's Progress as a fraction of the leading faction's, thousandths.** 0x522BD0, four `ret 4` exits (0x522C40, 0x522C57, 0x522C87, 0x522CB6). max = -1000, then over the game state's faction list (+0xCE4, node {value, ?, next at +8}) every faction whose slot 7 (IsValid) answers true raises max to its Progress (+0xAC). If max < floor(10.5f) = 10 (0.010 of a point; the float at 0x160A680 through 0x401FD0 and _ftol): 0. If max == 0: -1 - **unreachable**, since that arm comes after the < 10 test. Otherwise Progress * 1000 / max, truncating (32-bit when Progress is within (-1610612, 2147483), else 64-bit). No direct caller and no virtual table: reached only through its luabind registration. Neither Their Finest Hour's Lua nor BlackICE's calls it.
addresses.evidence: luabind.json registers 0x522BD0 (5385168) as CFaction::GetNormalizedProgress, `CFixedPoint GetNormalizedProgress(CFaction const&)`, __thiscall; findRefs --address finds the one reference in the registration at 0x8FCF78. Body decoded whole 0x522BD0..0x522CB6. grep of tfh/script, script and BlackICE for GetNormalizedProgress: no hits. Wrong if the faction list at +0xCE4 holds something other than CFaction* in its node's first dword (CGameState::ResetSession's comment says it does).

addresses.name: RunHourlyProvincePass
addresses.comment:
**The province's hourly work, and the only thing that adds to a faction's Progress.** 0x49E600 to the `ret 4` at 0x49EAAC (a second `ret 4` at 0x49EA93 is an exit of the same frame); RunDailyProvincePass starts after one int3 at 0x49EAB0. One caller, RunHourlyPass at 0x682A75, in a loop over every province of the game state's vector whose template's `simulated` byte (+0xD4 -> +0x13D) is set; the function tests the byte again itself.

Its head, read on the listing:

    controller = CCountryTag::GetCountry(&province->controller (+0x334))
    controller->faction (+0xD8)->Progress (+0xAC) += province->victory_points (+0x34) * 1000
    controller->+0x11CC                         += province->victory_points * 1000

So Progress is the victory points of the provinces the faction's members **control** - not own, not cores - credited to whatever faction the controller is in at that hour; a controller in no faction credits the shared null faction. The rest of the body (from 0x49E664: owned provinces in no real area walk their neighbours and may be handed to another controller through Province_SetController(..., 1, 1, 1) at 0x49EA3D; then RebuildProvinceModifierValues where a building's +0x28 byte is set) was seen in the decompiler only and is **not read**.
addresses.evidence: inferred for the name and for everything after 0x49E664; the Progress and +0x11CC adds at 0x49E635..0x49E65E are read off the listing (`lea ecx,[ebx+0x334]; call 0x402610; mov ecx,[ebx+0x34]; mov edx,[eax+0xd8]; imul ecx,ecx,0x3e8; add [edx+0xac],ecx`). fieldchain --holder 0xD8 --field 0xAC finds this the only write through CCountry::faction (the other two hits are reads in CCombat::PickTactics through an unrelated +0xD8). Savegame: Progress 115/263/173 equals the summed `points` of provinces whose controller is a member, in all twelve of the maintainer's saves (owner gives the same figures there, so the saves do not separate the two; the instruction does).

addresses.name: RunHourlyPass_ResetFactionProgress
addresses.comment: `mov dword ptr [eax+0xac], 0` inside RunHourlyPass: **every hour, before the province pass adds to it, each ideology group's faction has its Progress set to 0.** The loop at 0x68274F..0x6827BD walks the ideology database's groups ([0x1A878BC] +0x1C..+0x20) and takes each group's faction (+0x54) - or, for a group with none, the null faction (lazily built) - and zeroes it. **The null faction is zeroed only for a group with no faction**: Their Finest Hour's three groups all have one, so - inferred, no other store resetting it having been found - the null faction's Progress is never reset and grows each hour by the victory points of every province controlled by a country in no faction (see FINDINGS-factionplay.md section C). Between this store and the province pass at 0x682A75 the per-country hourly pass and the unit functors run, so anything reading Progress there would see a partial sum; nothing in Their Finest Hour's or BlackICE's script does.
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0x682731..0x6827BD: the test `mov eax,[eax+0x54]; test eax,eax; jne 0x6827B0` and the null-faction arm storing into [0x1A855A8]. Every one of the 71 code references to 0x1A855A8 decoded 30 instructions on: this is the only `+0xAC` store near any of them (positive control: it finds this one), and CFaction's constructor's own store at 0x522539. common/ideologies.txt has three groups (fascism, democracy, communism), each with a `faction` block. Wrong if the null faction is rebuilt somewhere other than through 0x523620's lazy path (that would reset it).

addresses.name: VictoryConditions_DailyCheck
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0x543AB0..0x543D68: the scope built at 0x543AE1..0x543B38 (vftable 0x15B8AEC), the count array alloca'd from the factions vector (+8..+0xC) at 0x543B3E, the slot-6 call `mov edx,[edx+0x18]` at 0x543B88 on +0x24 (CAndTrigger slot 6 is CAndTrigger::Evaluate, 0x9D06E0), the date store at 0x543C4C, the met store at 0x543C55, the two game_finished tests at 0x543C79/0x543C83, the `cmp [edx+ecx*4], edi(+0x3C); jge` at 0x543CA3 and the slot 0x130/0x12C dispatch at 0x543D30..0x543D50. Callers by findRefs: 0x683062 (inside RunDailyPass, which functionStart misplaces - trap 2's 0x682630/0x682C20 pair) and 0x70EB80.

addresses.name: VictoryConditions_CountForFaction
addresses.comment: **How many victory conditions the faction has chosen**: finds `faction` in conditions->factions (+8..+0xC) and answers the length of the matching entry of conditions->chosen (+0x18, 16 bytes an entry), or 0 when the faction is not there. Bare `ret`s at 0x543D90 and 0x543DA7. One caller: CDiplomacyView::BuildTooltip at 0x780CBA, the faction symbol's delayed `"\n%d/%d"`, where it is the **second** figure. In Their Finest Hour it is 15 for each faction.
addresses.revises: inferred -> confirmed; the argument typed CVictoryConditionManager*, and it is now known that the object is the game state's +0xD08 and +0x18 is the chosen conditions, and which figure of "\n%d/%d" it is.
addresses.evidence: Decoded whole 0x543D70..0x543DA7. The caller at 0x780CB8..0x780CD5: `mov esi,eax(state+0xD08); call 0x543D70; push eax; mov eax,esi; call 0x543DB0; push eax; push '\n%d/%d'` - the count pushed first is the last argument, so the text is met/chosen. Wrong if +0x18 is not the chosen list - VictoryConditions_SetChosen (0x543E10) is what fills it.

addresses.name: VictoryConditions_CountMetForFaction
addresses.comment: **How many of the faction's chosen victory conditions are met** - the byte CVictoryCondition +0x68, which VictoryConditions_DailyCheck rewrites each day to whether the condition's trigger holds now, and which a load sets to whether a date was recorded. Same lookup as VictoryConditions_CountForFaction; bare `ret`s at 0x543DD4 and 0x543E05. Four callers: the victory-conditions alert in CAlertManager_Update (0x606C8E), CInGameIdler::ShowScenarioEndDialog (0x671CFA), the victory-conditions window's VCWindow_SetFactionProgress (0x6D302F) and the diplomacy screen's faction-symbol tooltip (0x780CC2, the first figure of "\n%d/%d").
addresses.revises: inferred -> confirmed: +0x68 is the met flag (written by VictoryConditions_DailyCheck at 0x543C55 and VictoryConditions_SetChosen at 0x544059); argument typed; the four callers identified.
addresses.evidence: Decoded whole 0x543DB0..0x543E05. findRefs --callers gives the four sites; each was decoded around the call. Wrong if any other writer of CVictoryCondition +0x68 exists - the only writers found were in 0x543AB0 and 0x543E10, both inside victoryconditions code (+0x68 is too common a displacement to scan the image for, trap 12).

addresses.name: VictoryConditions_SetChosen
addresses.signature: void __stdcall VictoryConditions_SetChosen(CFaction* faction@EAX, CVictoryConditionManager* conditions@EDX, void* namesAndDates@stack:4)
addresses.comment: **Sets a faction's chosen victory conditions from a list of names and dates.** 0x543E10 to `ret 4` at 0x54408F (and an early `ret 4` at 0x543E43 when the faction is not in the vector). First **clears game_finished (+0x40)**. Then: empties chosen[f] (+0x18), clears every condition's `chosen` byte (+0x69) in all[f] (+0x28), and for each pair of strings in the list (0x38 bytes a pair: name, date) - in the list's order, and for each condition of all[f] in the file's order - where the names are equal (length and bytes), appends the condition to chosen[f], sets its chosen byte, parses the date into +0x64 (0x44CDA0) and sets met (+0x68) = date > the null date (43800000, the global at 0x170D240). Two callers: CVictoryConditionManager::LoadKey's `faction` case (a save) and CChooseVictoryConditionsCommand::Execute. A trailing odd string - the faction's own name, which the save writes last - is dropped by the pair count. A name the faction's list does not hold is dropped in silence.
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0x543E10..0x543EAE and 0x544010..0x54408F on the listing; the matching loop between them read in the decompiler. Callers by findRefs: 0x544A42 (LoadKey) and 0x553870 (Execute), each setting EAX to the faction and EDX to state +0xD08 before the call. Wrong if the 0x38 stride is not two Hoi3CString (it is 2 x 0x1C, and SaveContents pushes name then FormatHourDate for each condition).

addresses.name: VictoryConditions_PostChosen
addresses.comment: **Turns the choice into commands**: for each faction of all (+0x28), every condition whose `chosen` byte (+0x69) is set gives its name and FormatHourDate(+0x64); where there is at least one, a CChooseVictoryConditionsCommand(factions[i], list) is made (0x5441FD) and posted through the in-game screen's session command channel (session +0x38, slot 6). `ret 4` at 0x544302. One caller, the front end's game start at 0x70E89C, where a byte at the session's +0x34 is set (not read). So the host's choice reaches every peer as commands, and VictoryConditions_SetChosen fills `chosen` on each.
addresses.evidence: inferred: the loop read in the decompiler; on the listing only the constructor call at 0x5441F0..0x5441FD, the ret 4 at 0x544302 and the one caller at 0x70E89C (`mov edi,[edi+0xd08]; push edi; call 0x5440a0`). Wrong if the post is not slot 6 of the channel (the same `[[session+0x38]]+0x18` call posts the other lobby commands beside it).

addresses.name: VictoryConditions_ChoosePrimaries
addresses.comment: **A scenario's choice: exactly the `primary = yes` conditions.** For every faction's list in all (+0x28), each condition's `chosen` (+0x69) = its `primary` (+0x6A). No count, no budget. `ret 4` at 0x544365. One caller, CSetHistoryDate::Execute at 0x6D6490, when a scenario is set.
addresses.evidence: Decoded whole 0x544310..0x544365. Wrong if +0x6A is not `primary`: CVictoryCondition::LoadKey's token 0x667 case is ParseBool(this+0x6A) at 0x543287 and its other case, 0x321, loads the trigger at +0x24.

addresses.name: VictoryConditions_ChooseRandomly
addresses.comment:
**A campaign's choice: the primaries, then random others, up to NUMBER_OF_VICTORY_CONDITIONS.** `ret 4` at 0x5444F5. A Mersenne Twister of its own, seeded from _time64 (0xB9AFDE, then 0xAA2BF0) - the wall clock, not the game's generator. Per faction, in all (+0x28) order, budget = conditions->number (+0x38), unchosen = list length:

    for c in list while budget > 0:  if c->primary: budget--, unchosen--;  c->chosen = c->primary
    repeat budget times while unchosen > 0:
        r = (signed) tempered draw % unchosen          ; cdq; idiv - may be negative
        if r < 0: pick = the last condition            ; even if already chosen
        else: walk from the last condition back, skipping chosen ones, and take the r-th unchosen
        pick->chosen = 1; unchosen--

The loop over primaries **stops** when the budget reaches 0, so conditions after that point keep whatever `chosen` byte they had. The tempering uses arithmetic shifts (`sar 0xb`, `sar 0x12`). In Their Finest Hour each faction has exactly 15 primaries and NUMBER_OF_VICTORY_CONDITIONS is 15, so the random part never runs and every faction gets its primaries. One caller, CSetHistoryDate::Execute at 0x6D6517, with no scenario.
addresses.evidence: Decoded whole 0x544370..0x5444F5: the budget loop at 0x5443F5..0x544418 with its `jle 0x54441a` exit, the draw at 0x544439..0x544492, the `js 0x5444bd` arm taking eax = size-1, the backward walk at 0x5444A4..0x5444BB. Primaries counted in common/faction_aims.txt: 15 per faction (axis, allies, comintern); the start save's `victory_conditions` block lists those 15 per faction with the null date. Wrong if 0xAA2BF0 is not an MT seed (MT19937Twist 0xAA2C80 is called on it at index 0).

addresses.name: VictoryConditions_FitChoiceToCount
addresses.no_signature: The manager arrives in ECX, the faction on the stack (`ret 4`, 0x54490A) and the list of names and dates in ESI, which no ordinary convention carries beside ECX.
addresses.comment: **The lobby's victory-condition window makes the player's choice exactly NUMBER_OF_VICTORY_CONDITIONS long** - VC_ACCEPT_DISABLED "$NUM$ conditions selected, will randomly add/remove to $TOTAL$.". With n pairs in the list (0x38 bytes each) against conditions->number (+0x38): more - remove n - number random pairs (an MT seeded from _time64, index = draw % count); fewer - add number - n random conditions of the faction's all (+0x28) not already named, each as its name and FormatHourDate(+0x64). One caller, CSelectVictoryConditionsView::OnAccept (0x71BBE6).
addresses.evidence: inferred: read in the decompiler only; on the listing the entry (`mov edi,ecx; mov ecx,[esi+4]; sub ecx,[esi]`, the /0x38 by 0x92492493) and the ret 4 at 0x54490A. Wrong if the pairs are not (name, date) - the save and the command use the same shape.

addresses.name: CChooseVictoryConditionsCommand::CChooseVictoryConditionsCommand
addresses.signature: CChooseVictoryConditionsCommand* __stdcall CChooseVictoryConditionsCommand::CChooseVictoryConditionsCommand(CChooseVictoryConditionsCommand* this, CFaction* faction, void* namesAndDates)
addresses.comment: The working constructor (0x553600 is the registry's default one): CCommand's members with type 0x753, then faction at +0x3C and a copy of the string vector at +0x40. `ret 0xC` at 0x5537CC. Three callers: VictoryConditions_PostChosen (0x5441FD), the command's own clone, slot 13 (0x553A41), and CSelectVictoryConditionsView::OnAccept (0x71BC07).
addresses.evidence: Decoded the entry and the stores; `ret 0xc` at 0x5537CC; findRefs --callers gives the three sites, each pushing (this, faction, &list). The object is 0x50 bytes (`push 0x50` before each). Wrong if +0x40 is not a vector copy (0x4148B0 is called on it with the argument).

addresses.name: CChooseVictoryConditionsCommand::Execute
addresses.comment: Slot 6. **VictoryConditions_SetChosen(this->faction (+0x3C), state->victory_conditions (+0xD08), &this->+0x40)** and nothing else - so every peer sets the same chosen list, and as a side effect clears game_finished.
addresses.evidence: Decoded whole: the game-state singleton boilerplate, then `mov edx,[esi+0xd08]; lea eax,[edi+0x40]; push eax; mov eax,[edi+0x3c]; call 0x543e10` at 0x553863..0x553870. vtable.py --holding: CChooseVictoryConditionsCommand slot 6 only.

addresses.name: CChooseVictoryConditionsCommand::IsValid
addresses.comment: Slot 14: true where the faction (+0x3C) is not null and its slot 7 (IsValid) answers true. The whole function.
addresses.evidence: Decoded whole 0x553A80..0x553A99. vtable.py --holding: CChooseVictoryConditionsCommand slot 14 only; CAssignLeaderCommand's slot 14 is recorded as IsValid.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::ShowVictoryConfirmDialog
addresses.comment: Slot 75: **the campaign's end.** Called by VictoryConditions_DailyCheck when a faction reaches VICTORY_CONDITIONS_TO_WIN with no scenario, and by CInGameIdler::Update (0x655CF0) whenever the clock is past the defines' end_date. Once (the byte +0x12E1): makes the 0x6C-byte dialog of `VCConfirm` (eu3dialog.gui) through 0x670C20 - CONFIRM_VC_VICTORY "Victory!" / CONFIRM_VC_DEFEAT "Defeat!", CONFIRM_VC_TEXT "$FACTION$ has achieved their victory conditions. Do you want to continue playing or resign the current game?", VC_RESIGN / VC_CONTINUE - and adds it (CEU3Idler::AddDialog). Then, every call, where slot 95 (the byte +0x12D8) is clear, slot 27. **Identified only**: the dialog's own text and buttons, and what slots 95 and 27 do, were not read.
addresses.evidence: Decoded whole 0x671A10..0x671A94 (bare ret). vtable.py --holding: CInGameIdler slot 75 only. 0x670C20 pushes 'VCConfirm' (0x670C47) and 'CONFIRM_VC_VICTORY' (0x670DDA). The callers: the slot-0x12C dispatch at 0x543D4A and at 0x655CE8.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::ShowScenarioEndDialog
addresses.comment: Slot 76: **a scenario's end**, by its victory conditions (VictoryConditions_DailyCheck) or by its `enddate` (CInGameIdler::Update, 0x655C3F). Where the dialog (+0x1D30) is not yet made: the keys ENDGAMEHEADER_, ENDGAMEBODY_ and ENDGAMEBUTTON_ + the scenario's name (+8) + "_" + the player's tag + **"_WIN" where VictoryConditions_CountMetForFaction(the player's faction) >= VICTORY_CONDITIONS_TO_WIN (+0x3C), else "_LOSS"** - e.g. ENDGAMEHEADER_Fall_Blau_GER_WIN "Victory!" - set into `endgame_dialog`'s `headline`, `bodytext` and `quit_button`; the three `scenario_*_win` pictures hidden and, on a win, scenario<x>_win shown. Then the same slot 95 / slot 27 tail as slot 75. **Identified only**: the picture's name and the dialog's buttons were not read. So in a scenario the player wins by his own faction's count, whoever ended the game.
addresses.evidence: vtable.py --holding: CInGameIdler slot 76 only. On the listing: the +0x1D30 test at 0x671B53, the three key prefixes at 0x671B69..0x671BA2, `mov esi,[eax+0x3c]` at 0x671CE4, `call 0x543db0` at 0x671CFA, `cmp eax,esi; jl` at 0x671D0A and '_WIN' at 0x671D10; the rest in the decompiler. The single ret at 0x6724CC. ENDGAME* keys checked in the install's localisation.

addresses.name: InGameIdler_EndDateCheck
addresses.comment: Inside CInGameIdler::Update: **the end date.** With a scenario (state +0xD0C): where the clock (+0xBDC) is **past** the scenario's `enddate` (CScenario +0xAC) - `jle` skips at equal - this->slot 76 (ShowScenarioEndDialog). With none: where the clock is past the defines' `end_date` (CDefines +0xC; '1948.1.1' in Their Finest Hour) - this->slot 75 (ShowVictoryConfirmDialog). The only reader of CScenario +0xAC. Whether this block runs every frame or behind a gate further up Update was not read.
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0x655C19..0x655CF0: `mov ecx,[eax+0xd0c]; cmp ecx,esi; je`, `mov edx,[eax+0xbdc]; cmp edx,[ecx+0xac]; jle; ... call [edx+0x130]`, and the GetDefines arm `cmp eax,[ecx+0xc]; jle; ... call [eax+0x12c]`. fieldchain --holder 0xD0C --field 0xAC: this is the only reader. Positive control for the method: --field 0x38 under holder 0xD08 found the four known accesses.

addresses.name: CSetHistoryDate::Execute
addresses.comment: Slot 6 of the lobby's start-date command. Runs history to the date (ExecuteHistoryToDate with this->+0x3C), sets the clock, RefreshAllCountries, clears the map's overlays and recolours it, sets two game settings (+0xF0 = 0xFF9A, +0xF4 = 2), then **clears both game_finished bytes (+0x40/+0x41, one word) and chooses the victory conditions: VictoryConditions_ChoosePrimaries in a scenario, VictoryConditions_ChooseRandomly without one.** Bare `ret` at 0x6D64A5; a cold arm past it runs to 0x6D6535 (trap 3).
addresses.evidence: inferred: read in the decompiler; on the listing the word store at 0x6D640F (fieldchain --holder 0xD08 --field 0x40 --writes) and the two calls at 0x6D6490 (0x544310) and 0x6D6517 (0x544370). vtable.py --holding: CSetHistoryDate slot 6 only. Wrong in its history half, which was not checked against the listing.

addresses.name: CSelectVictoryConditionsView::OnAccept
addresses.comment: The lobby's victory-condition window's accept button (its CButtonObserverGlue, built at 0x71B83D). Where the player's country is real and in a valid faction: the ticked entries of the window's list (an entry's +0x2C object's +0x60 == 1) give their condition's (entry +0x28) name and FormatHourDate(+0x64); VictoryConditions_FitChoiceToCount fits them to NUMBER_OF_VICTORY_CONDITIONS; a CChooseVictoryConditionsCommand(faction, list) is posted through the session's channel; the window is hidden. Otherwise only hidden. So **any member of a faction can send its faction's choice** from this button; who may open the window (VC_BUTTON_DISABLED_INVALID "Only countries that are faction leaders can select victory conditions.") was not read.
addresses.evidence: inferred: read in the decompiler; on the listing `mov ebx,ecx` at 0x71BA08, the calls at 0x71BBE6 (0x544500) and 0x71BC07 (0x553720), and the glue reference at 0x71B83D. Bare rets at 0x71BCD1/0x71BCF1.

addresses.name: VCWindow_SetFactionProgress
addresses.comment: The in-game victory-conditions window (`vc_window`, interface/vc_interface.gui), one faction's figures, called for 'axis', 'allies' and 'comintern' from its update (0x6D2990) when the day of the year changes: where the faction of that name is valid, `vc_<name>_progress_text` = "%d / %d" of VictoryConditions_CountMetForFaction and **NUMBER_OF_VICTORY_CONDITIONS (+0x38)**, and the bar `vc_<name>_progress` = met * 100 / +0x38. So the window counts against 15 while the game ends at 12. `ret 8` at 0x6D31FE.
addresses.evidence: inferred: read in the decompiler; the ret 8 by retsBefore, the call at 0x6D302F, the three pushes of 'axis'/'allies'/'comintern' at 0x6D2E27..0x6D2E46, and fieldchain's read of +0x38 at 0x71C8DE belongs to the lobby window, not this one - the +0x38 read here is the decompiler's (`*(conditions + 0x38)`).

structs.name: CVictoryConditionManager
structs.comment: The game's victory conditions, at CCurrentGameState +0xD08 (made by CGameState's constructor at 0x67D673, `push 0x44`). Per faction - three parallel vectors in the order the faction_aims file names the factions: the factions, the conditions chosen for the game, and every condition the file defines. Loaded from common/faction_aims.txt (LoadFactionAims) or from a scenario's own file; saved as `victory_conditions = { faction = { <name> <date> ... <faction> } ... game_finished = yes|no }`.
structs.evidence: operator new(0x44) and the vftable store 0x15C35F8 at 0x67D691; RTTI: CPersistent at 0, 6 slots. Layout from LoadFactionAims, VictoryConditions_DailyCheck, VictoryConditions_SetChosen and SaveContents/LoadKey.

structs.name: CVictoryCondition
structs.comment: One of a faction's victory conditions: a block of common/faction_aims.txt (`<name> = { trigger = { ... } primary = yes }`). Nothing else in it is read: only `trigger` and `primary` are keys.
structs.evidence: LoadFactionAims: operator new(0x6C) then the constructor 0x543140, which writes the vftable 0x15C35DC; RTTI: CPersistent at 0, 6 slots. CVictoryCondition::LoadKey's two cases.

structs.name: CChooseVictoryConditionsCommand
structs.comment: The command that sets a faction's chosen victory conditions on every peer: posted by the game start (VictoryConditions_PostChosen) and by the lobby window's accept (CSelectVictoryConditionsView::OnAccept). Saved as its CCommand members, the list and `faction`.
structs.evidence: push 0x50 before each construction (0x5441D4, 0x553A1C, 0x71BBEB); RTTI: CCommand at 0, 15 slots; its constructors write 0x15C3EA4.

struct_fields.name: factions_begin
struct_fields.comment: begin of the vector of factions, in the file's order (+0xC end, +0x10 capacity). Every per-faction vector below is indexed in step with it.
struct_fields.evidence: VictoryConditions_CountForFaction's lookup (0x543D7F..0x543D84) and LoadFactionAims's push of FindFactionByName.

struct_fields.name: factions_end
struct_fields.comment: end of the factions vector.
struct_fields.evidence: the count `([+0xC]-[+8]) >> 2` in all five readers.

struct_fields.name: chosen_begin
struct_fields.comment: begin of the per-faction vectors (16 bytes each: begin, end, capacity, and one more) of the conditions **chosen for this game** - what is tested, counted and saved. +0x1C end.
struct_fields.evidence: VictoryConditions_DailyCheck walks it (0x543B62); VictoryConditions_SetChosen fills it; SaveContents writes it.

struct_fields.name: chosen_end
struct_fields.comment: end of the chosen vectors.
struct_fields.evidence: `sar eax, 4` of [+0x1C]-[+0x18] at 0x543B4B.

struct_fields.name: all_begin
struct_fields.comment: begin of the per-faction vectors of **every** condition the file defines, in the file's order - what the choice is made from. +0x2C end.
struct_fields.evidence: LoadFactionAims (0x543430..0x543AA2) appends each new CVictoryCondition to the last entry of this vector; ChoosePrimaries and ChooseRandomly walk it; VictoryConditions_SetChosen looks names up in it.

struct_fields.name: all_end
struct_fields.comment: end of the all-conditions vectors.

struct_fields.name: number_of_victory_conditions
struct_fields.comment: How many conditions each faction picks: NUMBER_OF_VICTORY_CONDITIONS / 1000 (15) from the defines when the game state is made and when a scenario is left; a scenario's `number_of_victory_conditions` (CScenario +0x108) where above 0. The denominator of the victory-conditions window, not of winning.
struct_fields.evidence: Writes at 0x67D6B2 (constructor, defines country +0x68), 0x686365 and 0x686890 (MarkSimulatedProvinces); fieldchain --holder 0xD08 --field 0x38 finds those and two reads.

struct_fields.name: victory_conditions_to_win
struct_fields.comment: How many met conditions win: VICTORY_CONDITIONS_TO_WIN / 1000 (12) from the defines; a scenario's `victory_conditions_to_win` (CScenario +0x104) where above 0. Read by the daily check, the scenario end screen and the alert (75 per cent of it).
struct_fields.evidence: Writes at 0x67D6B5, 0x68636F and 0x686805; reads at 0x543CA0, 0x606C50, 0x607BA5, 0x60A845, 0x671CE4.

struct_fields.name: game_finished
struct_fields.comment: Set by VictoryConditions_DailyCheck when a faction wins; what SaveContents writes as `game_finished`. Cleared by VictoryConditions_SetChosen (each faction's choice), by CSetHistoryDate::Execute and by MarkSimulatedProvinces (with +0x41, one word).
struct_fields.evidence: 0x543CB2 (set), 0x544C01 (saved), 0x543E16 (byte clear), 0x6D640F/0x6860A6/0x6865CD (word clears).

struct_fields.name: game_finished_loaded
struct_fields.comment: **Where a save's `game_finished` is loaded** - not into +0x40. Either byte stops VictoryConditions_DailyCheck ending the game again, but only +0x40 is saved, so a save made after loading a finished game writes `game_finished = no`.
struct_fields.evidence: CVictoryConditionManager::LoadKey's token 0x755 case: `add esi, 0x41; call ParseBool` at 0x54495F; SaveContents reads only `[ebx+0x40]` at 0x544C01.

struct_fields.name: name
struct_fields.comment: The block's key in faction_aims.txt, e.g. `operation_sealion`; what the save and the commands name it by.
struct_fields.evidence: LoadFactionAims assigns the parsed key here; VictoryConditions_SetChosen compares against it (+0x18 length, +0x1C capacity, +8 data).

struct_fields.name: trigger
struct_fields.comment: The `trigger = { ... }` block, an embedded CAndTrigger evaluated with an empty scope each day.
struct_fields.evidence: The constructor writes CAndTrigger's vftable at +0x24 (0x543140); LoadKey's 0x321 case calls its slot 3; VictoryConditions_DailyCheck calls its slot 6.

struct_fields.name: date
struct_fields.comment: The hour the condition last started to hold; the null date (43800000) until then. Saved beside the name.
struct_fields.evidence: Set to the clock at 0x543C4C when it holds and was not met; parsed at 0x54403E on load; initialised from g_NullDate by the constructor.

struct_fields.name: met
struct_fields.comment: Whether the trigger held at the last daily check (rewritten every day, not latched); on load, whether a date after the null date was saved. What VictoryConditions_CountMetForFaction counts.
struct_fields.evidence: Stores at 0x543C55 and 0x544059; read at 0x543BA9 and 0x543DF5.

struct_fields.name: chosen
struct_fields.comment: Chosen for this game - set by the choice (ChoosePrimaries, ChooseRandomly) and by VictoryConditions_SetChosen; what VictoryConditions_PostChosen collects.

struct_fields.name: primary
struct_fields.comment: `primary = yes`: always chosen.
struct_fields.evidence: CVictoryCondition::LoadKey's 0x667 case, ParseBool(this + 0x6A) at 0x543287.

struct_fields.name: faction
struct_fields.comment: The faction whose choice this is; saved as `faction` by name.
struct_fields.evidence: The constructor stores its second argument here; Execute and IsValid read it; SaveContents writes its +0xC under `faction`.

struct_fields.name: conditions_begin
struct_fields.comment: begin of the vector of strings, name then date for each chosen condition (+0x44 end, +0x48 capacity).
struct_fields.evidence: Execute passes &this->+0x40 to VictoryConditions_SetChosen, which reads it in 0x38-byte pairs.

struct_fields.name: victory_conditions
struct_fields.comment: The victory conditions (CVictoryConditionManager, 0x44 bytes, made by the constructor). Saved as `victory_conditions` by CGameState::SaveContents, and the loader puts it back here.
struct_fields.evidence: CGameState's constructor stores the 0x44-byte object whose vftable it writes as 0x15C35F8 (CVictoryConditionManager's, by RTTI) - 0x67D673..0x67D6B8.

struct_fields.name: victory_conditions
struct_fields.comment: The victory conditions (CVictoryConditionManager). Saved as `victory_conditions` by CGameState::SaveContents, and the loader puts it back here. CCurrentGameState derives from CGameState and adds nothing at this offset.
struct_fields.evidence: As for CGameState +0xD08; every reader in this wave (0x683062, 0x553863, 0x780CA4, 0x606C44, 0x671CE4) dereferences it as the manager.

struct_fields.name: controlled_victory_points
struct_fields.comment: The victory points of the provinces this country controls, thousandths - the country's own share of what its faction's Progress sums. Zeroed at the end of RunCountryHourlyPass and added to by RunHourlyProvincePass, which runs after it in RunHourlyPass, so between hours it holds the last hour's sum. Its readers were not sought.
struct_fields.evidence: Zeroed at the tail of RunCountryHourlyPass (FINDINGS-schedule.md, 'country->+0x11CC = 0'); added to at 0x49E65E (`imul ecx,ecx,0x3e8; add [eax+0x11cc],ecx`, eax the controller from CCountryTag::GetCountry). Not in project.json, bicelib_findings.json (4556) or any GameClasses header.

struct_fields.name: Progress
struct_fields.comment: The game's own name for it, out of the Lua API (`CFaction::GetProgress`, rva 0x122BC0, is `lea eax,[ecx+0xac]; ret`). **The victory points of the provinces the faction's members control**, thousandths: zeroed every hour by RunHourlyPass (0x6827B1) and summed again by RunHourlyProvincePass over every simulated province, crediting the controller's faction. Saved as the faction's `progress`. The null faction's is never zeroed in a game whose ideology groups all have factions.
struct_fields.revises: comment only: added what the field holds and who writes it
struct_fields.evidence: 0x6827B1 (zero) and 0x49E64F (add); save: 115/263/173 = the members' controlled VP in the start save.
